MATCH (a:Issue)-[l]->(b:Issue)
WHERE type(l) IN ['BLOCKER','DEPENDS','DUPLICATE','SUPERSESSION']
WITH l, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN b ELSE a END AS s, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN a ELSE b END AS t
MATCH (s)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(ps:Person), (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(pt:Person)
WHERE ps<>pt
RETURN DISTINCT s.issueKey AS issue, t.issueKey AS target, l.linkId AS link, ps.personKey AS person, pt.personKey AS tp

MATCH (a:Issue)-[l]->(b:Issue)
WHERE type(l) IN ['BLOCKER','DEPENDS','DUPLICATE','SUPERSESSION']
WITH l, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN b ELSE a END AS s, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN a ELSE b END AS t
MATCH (s)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(ps:Person), (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(pt:Person)
WHERE ps<>pt
UNWIND [[s.issueKey,ps.personKey],[t.issueKey,pt.personKey]] AS x
RETURN DISTINCT x[0] AS issue, x[1] AS person, l.linkId AS link, ps.personKey AS id

MATCH (a:Issue)-[l]->(b:Issue)
WHERE type(l) IN ['BLOCKER','DEPENDS','DUPLICATE','SUPERSESSION']
WITH CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN b ELSE a END AS s, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN a ELSE b END AS t
MATCH (s)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(ps:Person), (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(pt:Person)
WHERE ps<>pt
RETURN DISTINCT ps.personKey AS id
